en: Desktop Alpha adds an in-app upgrade path for 1.6.2 users who choose the Alpha update channel. Upgrades from 1.6.2-alpha.2 remain supported. Import 1.x clipboard history during setup, then configure settings and pair devices again.
zh: 桌面内测版支持从已选择 Alpha 渠道的 1.6.2 正式版应用内升级，并继续支持从 1.6.2-alpha.2 升级。可在首次设置时导入 1.x 剪贴板历史。请重新配置设置并配对设备。
